key_insight: A multi-stage machine-learning screening workflow can shrink a 60,000+ composition CaCu5-type search space to a few hundred DFT candidates, enabling efficient discovery of promising permanent magnets.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical materials-design pipeline for rapidly narrowing vast alloy spaces to experimentally and computationally tractable magnet candidates.
method: Generate 60,000+ CaCu5-type compositions by element substitution.
Apply pretrained materials models, Materials Project data, and a magnetization predictor.
Filter by metallicity, negative formation energy, hull distance ≤ 50 meV/atom, and magnetization ≥ 0.75 T before DFT.
evidence_signal: The screening reduced the space to 439 DFT candidates, and 159 of those showed positive axial magnetic anisotropy energy favoring [001].
watch_item: The final rankings depend on the quality and transferability of the pretrained models and the chosen thresholds, so experimental validation remains essential.
paper_title: Data driven screening of CaCu$_5$-type magnetic structures
